reviews.title: Used to Be Great
reviews.text:
I have had this app since 2019 and the yearly paid subscription along with it. It was a game-changer for me, with a wide range of well-spoken guided mediations, ambient sounds, and peaceful lullabies. Over the years, I’ve noticed the selections available haven’t seemed less polished, as well as the UI becoming almost unusable (the buttons are literally covered up by each other and/or are off the screen).

Over time it also started signing me out more frequently, making it so that I had to sign in again for each use. This week I attempted to sign in and was given the message the my email or password couldn’t be located. I attempted password recovery and was given a message that my account couldn’t be located. I tried several times and got the same message.

I reached out to customer service and while they did respond quickly, they also weren’t able to locate my account. It disappeared and they had no explanation other than believing that I used the wrong email. I gave them evidence to show I was giving the correct email and they still refuted it was on them. I literally have a paid subscription attached to that email.

I miss the old Simple Habit. Don’t waste your time on whatever this is that they’ve become.

reviews.title: Tried to cancel with in 7 Days
Impossible to Cancel
reviews.text: The only way to cancel is to cancel your credit card. Do NOT register for any version of this app. It is NOT FREE.

reviews.title: App glitches occurring immediately upon downloading and using
reviews.text: I downloaded this app hoping it would be the meditation app I use. Right away, the app isn’t working properly. While setting up my customized feed with the prompts the app feeds you after creating an account, words were bleeding off the screen so I could not filly read the prompted questions. I was hoping the glitches would end there, but after answering all of the prompts and arriving at the app’s home screen, words and buttons are still not in their correct positions. There’s some glitch impacting the formatting. I’m just going to delete and try to find a different meditation app.

reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: The app will load on an Apple Watch but will not work! It will look like you can choose from 10 different meditations that vary from 1 to 5 minutes.  Bogus and false advertising! I wish I would have known this prior to purchasing subscription.  I have alerted Simple Habit and they don’t care.

reviews.title: It’s Gone Downhill
reviews.text: This is truly so sad. I’ve loved this app for years but it’s completely gone downhill. The app doesn’t appear to be supported on the tech side anymore. The icons, user experience is now very poor and even after being charged for my annual premium subscription my app still shows locked content. Also last year I was incorrectly charged twice and found out the hard way that this app has very minimal customer service. I’ve requested my account to be deleted and am so disappointed after using this app for many years. Also I keep getting charged years after cancelling and deleting the app.

reviews.title: Account not working!
reviews.text: Please respond to my support email. I will remove this review when my account is fixed. I paid for a year but can’t access Premium.
